keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Mile Svilar (Roma).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Giovanni Daffara (Parma).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Parma 0, Roma 1. Donyell Malen (Roma) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Emanuele Lulli with a cross following a set piece situation.
Delay in match because of an injury Gianluca Mancini (Roma).
Delay in match because of an injury El Bilal Touré (Parma).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Emanuele Valeri (Parma) is shown the yellow card.
First Half ends, Parma 0, Roma 1.
Goal! Parma 1, Roma 1. Nesta Elphege (Parma) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Mariano Troilo following a fast break.
Substitution, Roma. Wesley replaces Emanuele Lulli.
Substitution, Roma. Evan Ndicka replaces Leonardo Balerdi.
Substitution, Roma. Matías Soulé replaces Paulo Dybala.
Substitution, Parma. Simone Lontani replaces El Bilal Touré.
Substitution, Parma. Christian Ordóñez replaces Giovanni Fabbian.
Goal! Parma 1, Roma 2. Donyell Malen (Roma) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
Goal! Parma 1, Roma 3. Rodrigo Mora (Roma) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Substitution, Parma. Hans Nicolussi Caviglia replaces Vincent Sierro.
Substitution, Parma. Ousmane Diallo replaces Sascha Britschgi.
Goal! Parma 1, Roma 4. Donyell Malen (Roma) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Wesley with a cross.
Substitution, Roma. Konstantinos Koulierakis replaces Nahuel Molina.
Substitution, Roma. Niccolò Pisilli replaces Rodrigo Mora.
Substitution, Parma. Thomás de Martis replaces Nesta Elphege.
Goal! Parma 1, Roma 5. Donyell Malen (Roma) right footed shot from a difficult angle on the left to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Wesley following a fast break.
